blocks.text: Constructs are stations you build. A Constructor flies to the site and is used up building it.
The cost is paid as it builds. Sites need clear room.

Builds economy and support ships (warships come from a Shipyard), takes in cargo and defends itself, but makes no resources. Lose every starbase with no Constructor left to build another and you lose; losing your worlds alone does not. Keep it clear of nearly drained gas giants.
blocks.title: Starbase

blocks.text: Builds warships (starbases don't): a hull with the variant and researched Mod you pick (see Shipyards below).
blocks.title: Shipyard

blocks.text: A forward drop-off: harvesters unload here instead of flying home, so a station beside a far belt or nebula shortens every trip. Unarmed: guard it.
blocks.title: Mining Station

blocks.text: Half a starbase that only holds ground: no building, no cargo. Construct weapon research applies to its guns.
blocks.title: Frontier Outpost

blocks.text: Right-click it with ships selected to garrison them; they still cost upkeep and die with the gate.
blocks.title: Warp Gate

blocks.text: Stats read cost, build time, shield / armor / hull, guns and upkeep. Every construct gun is a standard ship laser.
Construct guns get flat extra reach, so every gun hits a corvette at max range from any angle.
The bonus ignores Mods and Munitions research.
